name: braid
description: Code autopilot: after every turn that changes code, real checks, a fresh-eyes review, refuted findings and test-first fixes, automatically. Any stack; knows Godot, Unreal and Unity. Pairs with ponytail.

gate.title: Stop gate mode
gate.description: auto (checks, then the review loop), fast (fast checks only), all (every check), or off. Leave empty to let each project's .claude/braid.json decide. The BRAID_GATE environment variable overrides it.
